findings.description: AWS access-key material is embedded in the Lambda environment variables and therefore in Terraform source/state and readable through Lambda configuration access. Any real credential placed here can be exposed to repository, state, or IAM principals with describe/configuration permissions.
The function uses the deprecated nodejs12.x runtime, which no longer receives security patches. Known runtime vulnerabilities may remain exploitable in the deployed function.
